profile.name: Rishad Rafeeq
profile.headline: I design and build fast, modern websites that grow businesses.
profile.about: I'm a full-stack web developer who builds fast, modern websites and web apps — from enterprise company sites and business-setup portals in the UAE to e-commerce stores with complete admin panels. I also run my own product, VFUTURES, a trading community and platform with a YouTube channel, and I help brands grow through Instagram lead generation.
